purpose: 复用同一实际5目录，29企业家原发布页各一次、真实附件各一次；不认证、不重取、不接触股市标签。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import json,hashlib,re,requests,threading
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R;SOURCE=OUT/'sources'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(name):return json.loads((OUT/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save_new(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'既有原件回执不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
lock=threading.Lock()
def log(z):
 with lock:
  with (OUT/'实际取件调用账本.jsonl').open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps(z,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
def fetch(url,path,kind,q):
 assert not path.exists(),'原目标已有，不能重取：'+q+' '+kind
 assert urlparse(url).hostname.endswith('.pbc.gov.cn') or urlparse(url).hostname=='pbc.gov.cn'
 log({'kind':kind,'quarter':q,'url':url,'request_started_at':now()})
 try:
  resp=requests.get(url,timeout=30);path.write_bytes(resp.content)
  rec={'kind':kind,'quarter':q,'requested_url':url,'final_url':resp.url,'status_code':resp.status_code,'local_received_at':now(),'path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(path),'content_type':resp.headers.get('Content-Type'),'retry':False}
  log({'receipt':rec});resp.raise_for_status();return rec
 except Exception as exc:
  log({'kind':kind,'quarter':q,'url':url,'failed_at':now(),'exception_type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc),'retry':False})
  raise
targets=readj('全部29原企业家问卷目录映射.json')['targets'];first=readj('首个原企业家发布页实际回执.json')
assert not (OUT/'全部29企业家原发布钟与附件.json').exists()
def acquire(z):
 q=z['quarter'];out={'quarter':q,'catalog_title':z['title'],'release_url':z['release_url']}
 try:
  p=SOURCE/('release_'+q+'.html')
  if q==first['quarter']:
   assert sha(p)==first['sha256'];rec=first;out['release_reused_from_current_stage_first']=True
  else:rec=fetch(z['release_url'],p,'release',q)
  soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),'html.parser');body=soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)
  meta={a.get('name'):a.get('content') for a in soup.find_all('meta') if a.get('name')}
  title=meta.get('ArticleTitle','');assert re.sub(r'\s+','',title)==re.sub(r'\s+','',z['title']),'原发布标题不符'
  clocks=sorted(set(re.findall(r'20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}',body)))
  assert len(clocks)==1 and clocks[0].startswith(meta.get('PubDate','')),'实际原显示钟不唯一/与PubDate不符'
  attachments=[{'url':urljoin(rec['final_url'],a['href']),'title':a.get_text(' ',strip=True)} for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True) if '.pdf' in a['href'].lower()]
  attachments=list({a['url']:a for a in attachments}.values());assert len(attachments)==1,'本季原PDF附件不唯一'
  pdfrec=fetch(attachments[0]['url'],SOURCE/(q+'.pdf'),'pdf',q)
  assert (SOURCE/(q+'.pdf')).read_bytes().startswith(b'%PDF-'),'原附件不是PDF'
  out.update({'original_article_title':title,'original_pubdate_meta':meta['PubDate'],'original_display_release_clock':clocks[0]+'+08:00','page_createDate_not_historical_clock':meta.get('createDate'),'raw_meta':meta,'release_receipt':rec,'original_attachment':attachments[0],'pdf_receipt':pdfrec,'acquisition_status':'ORIGINAL_RELEASE_AND_CURRENT_ATTACHMENT_RECEIVED'})
 except Exception as exc:out.update({'acquisition_status':'UNKNOWN_SOURCE_ACQUISITION_OR_IDENTITY_FAILED','exception_type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)})
 return out
rows=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as ex:
 futures=[ex.submit(acquire,z) for z in targets]
 for fut in as_completed(futures):
  row=fut.result();rows.append(row)
  print('已完成原企业家季度取得：'+row['quarter']+' '+row['acquisition_status']+'；'+str(len(rows))+'/29',flush=True)
by={z['quarter']:z for z in rows};rows=[by[z['quarter']] for z in targets]
save_new('全部29企业家原发布钟与附件.json',{'completed_at':now(),'target_quarters':29,'original_catalogs_reused':5,'new_catalog_GETs':0,'targets':rows,'successes':sum(z['acquisition_status']=='ORIGINAL_RELEASE_AND_CURRENT_ATTACHMENT_RECEIVED' for z in rows),'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0})
print(json.dumps({'原29取得完成':True,'成功':sum(z['acquisition_status']=='ORIGINAL_RELEASE_AND_CURRENT_ATTACHMENT_RECEIVED' for z in rows),'未通过':[{k:v for k,v in z.items() if k in ['quarter','message','exception_type']} for z in rows if z['acquisition_status']!='ORIGINAL_RELEASE_AND_CURRENT_ATTACHMENT_RECEIVED'],'新目标重取':0,'来源金额访问':False},ensure_ascii=False))
